readerCopy.body: Permission can turn into excess when every limit starts to resemble the restrictions that were finally rejected. When Jupiter squares Lilith, expansion and autonomy create friction, making more spending, risk, attention, freedom, promises, or exceptions feel like proof of honesty. Refusing shame does not require abandoning judgment. The desire becomes easier to understand when enough freedom exists to test it without making every impulse a commitment.
